notes.title: The New Squad, Novastone
notes.notes:
You can now meet a new squad, Novastone in the store.
Novastone has high defense and protects the player from danger by taunting enemies.

notes.title: New Hero, Gadget!
notes.notes:
From now on, you can play as a new hero, Gadget!
Gadget can deploy drones to attack enemies or order them to heal allies.

notes.title: New Boss - Inquisitor
notes.notes:
A new boss, 'Inquisitor' is arrived.
Defeat Inquisitor on the 5th stage in Survival Mode and get a radical core!

notes.title: A new hero has arrived!
notes.notes:
- Play the new hero Twinblaster. He is a powerful character using a dual gun.
- Added an upgrade. You can choose up to 3 upgrades.

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
- Added Survival mode clear achievement.
- Destroying monsters in Survival Mode now correctly reflects Destroyer achievements.
- You can no longer have more than 999 cores in Survival mode.
- Changed the character selection UI.

notes.title: New game mode! 'Survival'
notes.notes:
Defeat endless enemies on the new battlefield and earn more rewards.
This is a co-op mode that you can play with your friends.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
- Clearing the Singleplayer Stage now gives you a chance to earn Radial Core.
- Added upgrade system. You can upgrade using Radical Core.
- You can change the skin of the character. You can purchase skins with Radical Core.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
- Now combat will start with active skill and evasion skill.
- The difficulty of some stages has become easier.
